meta.method: dev-DB manipulation of agent_certificates validity window (PPANEL_AGENT_CERT_DAYS min is 1 day; no clock faking)

steps.step: cert near expiry → agent rotates on its own and keeps heartbeating with the new cert
expired agent cert → gateway refuses (401 AGENT_CERT_REVOKED), server goes stale/offline, agent process keeps running and does not touch workloads
validity restored → agent reconnects by itself (backoff at max after 401)

steps.finding: apps/api/src/agent/gateway.server.ts issues the gateway cert once at start (90-day validity, ca.service.ts issueGatewayCert) and never re-issues/hot-swaps it; a Center running > 90 days without restart would lose every agent. Not exercised live (needs clock manipulation).

steps.step: near-expiry FAIL above is a harness error: moving only not_before back lengthened the life to 13 d, so renewAfter (notBefore + 2/3 life) was still in the future. Re-run with a correct window → PASS, rotated after 14.5 s (p7-disaster-cert-rotation.json)
